text: Which chemical element has the symbol 'H' and atomic number 1?
hindiText: किस रासायनिक तत्व का प्रतीक 'H' और परमाणु संख्या 1 है?
explanation: Hydrogen is the chemical element with the symbol H and atomic number 1. It is the lightest element in the periodic table.

text: What is the acceleration due to gravity on Earth's surface?
hindiText: पृथ्वी की सतह पर गुरुत्वाकर्षण के कारण त्वरण क्या है?
explanation: The standard acceleration due to gravity on Earth's surface is approximately 9.8 m/s².

text: Which organ in the human body is responsible for pumping blood?
hindiText: मानव शरीर में कौन सा अंग रक्त पंप करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
explanation: The heart is a muscular organ in most animals, which pumps blood through the blood vessels of the circulatory system.

text: What process do plants use to convert sunlight into chemical energy?
hindiText: पौधे सूर्य के प्रकाश को रासायनिक ऊर्जा में बदलने के लिए किस प्रक्रिया का उपयोग करते हैं?
explanation: Photosynthesis is the process used by plants, algae, and certain bacteria to harness energy from sunlight and turn it into chemical energy.

text: Which of the following are greenhouse gases? (Select all correct options)
hindiText: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी ग्रीनहाउस गैसें हैं? (सभी सही विकल्प चुनें)
explanation: Greenhouse gases include water vapor, carbon dioxide, methane, nitrous oxide, and ozone. Nitrogen and Oxygen are not greenhouse gases.
